title: 第859章 古殿少主洛子雲第858章 回归古界半路盘查
content_zh:
一望无际的大草原上，搭建着无数帐篷，从天空往下看，宛如一个个巨大的绿色蘑菇。
这里是沧澜古界正道联盟大本营，名曰千里原。
中间一个普通的帐篷营中，几名修士正在商议作战方针，一名属下急匆匆走了进来。
“首领、少主、各位长老，刚接到柳宗远道友来报，天工院副院长落天生被人救了出来，救他之人是九色传人张扬。柳道友让他们过来接受审查，张扬说落天生身受重伤，急需回院治疗，无法过来。”
“落天生什么情况？”正道联盟首领苗园圃问。
“柳道友说落天生气息很乱，仿佛苍老了数百年，很有可能被魔族用了腐身之刑。”
听到‘腐身之刑’四个字，周围众人脸色纷纷变了。
“该死的魔族，就知道他们会对落道友上手段。”旁边一名长老一拍桌面，对苗园圃说道，“首领，落道友战功赫赫，落得如此下场，咱们理应慰问一下，要不让我过去查明情况。”
“何长老，你有没有想过，他为什么能回来？”旁边轻飘飘传过来一句话，声音异常冷漠。
“洛少主，这腐身之刑、元婴百日禁咒，不是魔族的惯用伎俩吗？”何长老回道。
“落天生回来，我能理解。张扬回来，我不能理解。他为什么会出现在大魔界，又凭什么从那边回来，难道你们就不怕……他是魔族奸细？”洛子雲冷冷地说道。
几名长老面面相觑，神情都怪异起来。
数十年前，张扬在天工院结婴，引发九色神雷，震惊整个沧澜古界。
后来，又在赛雅族的朝圣大典之上，破坏了魂殿少主的阴谋，毁了鬼云幡，救万民于水火之中，从此名声大震，被誉为年轻一辈当中的第一元婴修士。
在此之前，这个年轻一辈第一修士的名头，是古殿少主洛子雲的。
嫉妒之心，由此滋长。
十几年前，洛子雲奔赴前线，想要会一会这个所谓的九色传人，结果张扬没出现，天工院派了另一个人过来。为此他多次在公众场合奚落张扬，说一个连征仙令都不敢接的人，根本没有资格跟他相提并论。为此他还处处为难落天生，派给他最危险的任务。这次落天生被抓，他是直接原因。
“子雲说得没错。”苗园圃第一时间表示赞同，“从大魔界过来的人，无论是谁都要接受审查，这是原则性问题。你通知柳宗远，无论如何都要将人拦下，如果对方还是不配合，就采取强制性手段。”
“柳道友说他们办不到。”
“为何？”

“他说，张扬已经进阶元婴中期，气势强得吓人。”
此言一出，周围众人，脸色全都变了。
“你确定，他已经元婴中期了？”何长老问。
“柳道友说了几遍，不会错。而且，那飞船之内还有一名元婴修士没冒头，神识也极其强大，似乎也是元婴中期，有可能——就是当初跟张扬一起结婴、引发七色雷劫的雷秋雪。”
周围全是倒吸凉气的声音，一个人进阶也就罢了，这两人还一起进阶了？
这才短短不到七十年时间，这进阶速度也太快了吧！
“怎么，你们堂堂大修士，连一个元婴中期都害怕吗？”洛子雲冷嘲一声，瞳孔中的嫉妒心更重，“按照规定，无论是谁从大魔界过来，都要接受安全审查，你们连这点魄力都没有，索性别当古殿长老了。”
“少主，张扬当年与云沏的恩怨，众所周知，他又是天工院的人，应该不可能是内奸。再说，落院长身受重伤，他急着赶回去也在情理之中。”何姓长老说道。
“何长老，规矩不能改。”
旁边的长老见洛子雲脸上变色，赶紧朝他打眼色。
何长老还想说什么，最终还是忍了下来，黑着脸走到一边。
“何长老，这件事情，你去办，把人带回来。”苗园圃作为大首领，最后还是发了话。
content_en:
Countless tents were set up on the endless prairie. Looking down from the sky, they looked like huge green mushrooms.
This is the base camp of the Canglan Ancient Realm Righteous Alliance, called Qianliyuan.
In an ordinary tent camp in the middle, several monks were discussing the battle strategy, and a subordinate hurriedly walked in.
"Chief, Young Master, and elders, we just received a report from fellow Taoist Liu Zongyuan that Luo Tiansheng, the vice president of Tiangongyuan, was rescued. The person who rescued him was Zhang Yang, the descendant of Nine Colors. Fellow Taoist Liu asked them to come over for examination. Zhang Yang said that Luo Tiansheng was seriously injured and urgently needed to return to the hospital for treatment and could not come over."
"What happened to Luosheng?" asked Miao Yuanpu, the leader of the Righteous Path Alliance.
"Fellow Daoist Liu said that Luo Tian's aura was very messy, as if he had aged for hundreds of years, and it was very likely that he had been tortured by the demons."
Hearing the words 'Corruption Punishment', the expressions of everyone around him changed.
"The damn demons, I knew they would resort to tricks on Fellow Daoist Luo." An elder next to him slapped the table and said to Miao Yuanpu, "Chief, Fellow Daoist Luo has made great achievements in battle and ended up like this. We should express our condolences, or let me go over and find out the situation."
"Elder He, have you ever thought about why he came back?" A word came from the side, and the voice was unusually cold.
"Young Master Luo, aren't the punishment of body corruption and the hundred-day forbidden curse of the Nascent Soul a common trick of the demon clan?" Elder He replied.
"I can understand Luosheng's return. I can't understand Zhang Yang's return. Why did he appear in the Great Demon Realm, and why did he come back from there? Aren't you afraid... that he is a demon spy?" Luo Ziyun said coldly.
Several elders looked at each other with strange expressions.
Decades ago, Zhang Yang gave birth to a baby in Tiangongyuan, which triggered the nine-color divine thunder and shocked the entire Canglan ancient world.
Later, at the pilgrimage ceremony of the Saiyan tribe, he destroyed the conspiracy of the young master of the Soul Palace, destroyed the Ghost Cloud Flag, and saved all the people from the fire and water. From then on, he became famous and was known as the number one Nascent Soul monk among the younger generation.
Before that, the title of the first monk of the younger generation belonged to Luo Ziyun, the young master of the ancient palace.
Jealousy grows from this.
More than ten years ago, Luo Ziyun went to the front line and wanted to meet the so-called descendant of the Nine Colors. However, Zhang Yang did not show up and Tiangongyuan sent another person. For this reason, he repeatedly ridiculed Zhang Yang in public, saying that a person who dared not even accept the Immortal Conquest Order was not qualified to be compared with him. For this reason, he still embarrassed Luo Tiansheng everywhere and assigned him the most dangerous tasks. He was the direct reason why Luosheng was arrested this time.
"Zi Yun is right." Miao Yuanpu agreed immediately. "Anyone who comes from the Great Demon Realm must be examined no matter who they are. This is a matter of principle. You inform Liu Zongyuan that you must stop the person no matter what. If the other party still does not cooperate, coercive measures will be taken."
"Fellow Daoist Liu said they couldn't do it."
"Why?"
"He said that Zhang Yang has advanced to the middle stage of Nascent Soul, and his aura is frighteningly strong."
As soon as these words came out, the expressions of everyone around him changed.
"Are you sure he is already in the middle stage of Nascent Soul?" Elder He asked.
"Fellow Daoist Liu has said it several times, and it's not wrong. Moreover, there is a Nascent Soul cultivator who has not yet appeared in the spaceship, and his spiritual consciousness is also extremely powerful. He seems to be in the middle stage of the Nascent Soul. It is possible that it is Lei Qiuxue who had a baby with Zhang Yang and caused the seven-color thunder catastrophe."
There were gasps all around. It was enough for one person to advance, but these two advanced together?
It has only been less than seventy years, so the speed of advancement is too fast!
"Why, are you great monks afraid of even a middle-stage Nascent Soul?" Luo Ziyun sneered, the jealousy in his pupils getting heavier, "According to regulations, no matter who comes from the Great Demon Realm, he must undergo a security review. You don't even have this courage, so you are simply becoming the elders of the ancient palace."
"Young Master, the relationship between Zhang Yang and Yun Chuan back then...As we all know, he is from Tiangongyuan, so it should be impossible for him to be a traitor. Besides, Dean Luo was seriously injured, so it was reasonable for him to rush back in a hurry. "The elder surnamed He said.
“Elder He, the rules cannot be changed. "
The elder next to him saw the color change on Luo Ziyun's face and quickly winked at him.
Elder He wanted to say something else, but finally endured it and walked aside with a dark face.
"Elder He, go handle this matter and bring this person back. "As the big leader, Miao Yuanpu finally spoke.
